title: Ivo and the Typewriter
author: Casper Ishikawa
blurb: Dominic Reyes, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
